acceptable.text: Merging a PR to main in the ASF repo publishes a new patch release (tag and images) automatically, so no manual release step is needed.
acceptable.evidence: Merging #65 and #66 had already published v1.21.4 and v1.21.5 automatically, so no release step was needed.

notes: Routine: user says PRs are merged; assistant rebases a PR, resolves a CHANGELOG conflict, waits for CI, updates the local ASF stack to the published release and reruns the Hive tests. All status / what-was-done; nothing durable beyond what the code and changelog already say. Label review: the session proves ASF auto-releases on merge (the assistant had planned a manual release); that is a true durable fact, so it is acceptable, though not required from a routine window.
